title: A Survey on Collaborative Mechanisms Between Large and Small Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2505.07460v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) deliver powerful AI capabilities but face deployment challenges due to high resource costs and latency, whereas Small Language Models (SLMs) offer efficiency and deployability at the cost of reduced performance. Collaboration between LLMs and SLMs emerges as a crucial paradigm to synergistically balance these trade-offs, enabling advanced AI applications, especially on resource-constrained edge devices. This survey provides a comprehensive overview of LLM-SLM collaboration, detailing various interaction mechanisms (pipeline, routing, auxiliary, distillation, fusion), key enabling technologies, and diverse application scenarios driven by on-device needs like low latency, privacy, personalization, and offline operation. translated_title: 大语言模型与小语言模型协同机制综述
translated_abstract: 大语言模型能够提供强大的AI能力，但由于高昂的资源成本和延迟而面临部署挑战；而小语言模型以牺牲部分性能为代价，提供了高效率与可部署性。大语言模型与小语言模型之间的协作成为一种关键范式，可以协同平衡这些权衡取舍，从而支持先进的AI应用，尤其是在资源受限的边缘设备上。本综述对LLM-SLM协作进行了全面概述，详细介绍了各种交互机制（流水线、路由、辅助、蒸馏、融合）、关键使能技术，以及由设备端需求（如低延迟、隐私保护、个性化和离线运行）所驱动的多样化应用场景。在强调构建更高效、更灵活、更易获取的AI所具有的巨大潜力的同时，我们还讨论了持续存在的挑战，包括系统开销、模型间一致性等（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了大语言模型与小语言模型之间五种协作机制（流水线、路由、辅助、蒸馏、融合）及其关键使能技术和面向边缘设备的应用场景，为构建高效、灵活且易获取的AI系统提供了全面的参考框架。
en_tdlr: This survey comprehensively reviews LLM-SLM collaboration mechanisms—including pipeline, routing, auxiliary, distillation, and fusion—along with enabling technologies and edge-device application scenarios, providing a holistic framework for building efficient, adaptable, and accessible AI.
